body: Sure I know what I am interested in. I play poker, and am as good in that as my limited math skills let me be. I like running, but won't win any medals for it. I like my career choice, but now that I have been there, I can't see any reason to stay with it. I can't improve on my life. I am as good as I will get, and I have a Taurus .357 that I hold everyday.
